title: Serenity Co-ordinates
description: A lightweight coordinate HUD that displays your position, facing direction, and in-game time above the hotbar.
body:
A lightweight, clean coordinate HUD for NeoForge that stays out of your way while giving you exactly what you need.

Serenity Coords displays your XYZ position, facing direction, and in-game time in a compact, stylized overlay above the hotbar — designed to feel like it belongs in vanilla.

✨ Features

    •	📍 Real-time coordinates (block-accurate XYZ)
	•	🧭 Cardinal direction (N / S / E / W)
	•	⏰ In-game clock (24-hour format)
	•	🎯 Centered above hotbar — no clutter, no overlap
	•	🎨 Clean color styling for quick readability
	•	⌨️ Toggle with a keybind (default: C)
	•	⚡ Lightweight & client-side only

🎮 Designed for gameplay

No debug screen. No oversized UI. No data functions.
Just the information you actually use — always visible, never distracting.

⚙️ Compatibility
	•	NeoForge 26.1+
	•	Client-side only (safe for servers)
